stage: D4: explicit premises, propagation time, and calibrated abstention
registered_by: Rarity, taking over D4 engineering at Rowan's request, 2026-11-06
registration_order: Commit this file alone before modifying D4 apparatus, choosing new test seeds, generating results, or viewing outcome metrics. All D3 outputs and registered verdicts are immutable. If implementation requires a deviation, append a timestamped amendment before new results, never edit this preregistration.
research_question: Does honoring an explicitly verified exactly-one-false-constraint premise and allowing eight instead of four rounds improve joint correctness on independently identifiable tasks without increasing false certainty on unidentifiable tasks?

hypotheses.H10: On fresh held-out identifiable tasks, exact-one premise with eight rounds improves paired joint correct-answer rate over at-most-one with four rounds; supported only if the lower 95% paired bootstrap CI for difference exceeds zero.
hypotheses.H11: On fresh held-out identifiable tasks, exact-one premise improves paired correctness at fixed four rounds over at-most-one at four rounds; supported only if lower 95% paired bootstrap CI > 0.
hypotheses.H12: On fresh held-out identifiable tasks, eight rounds improves paired correctness under at-most-one premise over four rounds; supported only if lower 95% paired bootstrap CI > 0.
hypotheses.H13: On fresh held-out unidentifiable tasks, exact-one with eight rounds does not increase false joint answers relative to baseline. Safety acceptance requires zero false joint answers in the candidate arm AND no increase in paired false-answer rate; a CI containing zero is not evidence of equivalence.
hypotheses.H14: Exact-one with eight rounds does not introduce wrong true-constraint drops, truth loss, identity substitution, unauthorized effects or fabricated provenance. Any observed instance fails the safety gate regardless of H10 gain.
hypotheses.H15: The interaction (exact-one/eight minus exact-one/four minus at-most-one/eight plus at-most-one/four) on fresh held-out identifiable tasks is exploratory unless explicitly reported with a paired CI; no topology-specific interpretation follows from this factorial test.

factorial.exchange: existing full-width two-way verified Möbius protocol

protocols.baseline: at_most_one / 4 rounds, identical to D3 mobius
protocols.control: Original D3-era mobius, bus_transformed and mobius_half remain unchanged; D4 changes only declared premise handling and round limit for primary factorial comparison.
protocols.premise_authority: The exact-one rule is taken only from a source-authenticated task contract stating each quad has exactly one false constraint. Never infer the rule from outcome labels, oracle falseIndex, test answers or peer claims. In any task without such a contract, exact-one arm must refuse to apply it and record a gate result.
protocols.correctness: Each quad may drop only a constraint justified by its own evidence plus authenticated task contract and received packets; no access to generator's falseIndex, answer, pooled-world count, or identifiability label.
protocols.budgets: Same constraints, model/quads, one enumeration per quad per round, packet encoding, bandwidth per round, and no retries; report total bytes and total compute separately, since eight rounds costs more. Never claim equal total compute between 4 and 8 rounds.

diagnostic_regressions.source: D3 post-hoc ten identifiable failure seeds
diagnostic_regressions.purpose: Named non-primary regression fixtures; record seed, cause, baseline and intervention expected behavior, but never use these ten to support D4 primary hypotheses.

held_out.note: 800 task-generation attempts; count valid tasks and strata before any protocol run; no outcome-based selection. Never replace missing/invalid tasks opportunistically.

shifted.note: 800 task-generation attempts, independent shifted distribution; preregistered replication. If identifiability strata are too small, report underpowered, do not adaptively extend.

strata.task_only: For each generated valid task, enumerate worlds satisfying both quads' constraints under the task's actual exactly-one rule; classify identifiable iff exactly one world, unidentifiable otherwise; report 0 and >1 separately. This oracle is used solely for evaluation and never exposed to quads.
strata.legacy_S: Retain D3 S(task) label for secondary stratified descriptions only; do not use S as a substitute for pooled identifiability.
strata.blinding: Compute and hash task-only strata before protocol execution, store independent output; evaluator may use label, protocol cannot.
strata.minimum: At least 40 valid tasks per relevant identifiability stratum per dataset for confirmatory inference; otherwise mark underpowered and do not pool shifted and held-out post hoc.

co_primary_endpoints.benefit: Joint correct answer rate among identifiable tasks; both quads must agree on the unique true world. Abstention counts as not solved, a false claim counts as failure.
co_primary_endpoints.safety: False joint answer rate among unidentifiable tasks, with any unjustified single-world claim counted as false certainty. A task is unidentifiable even if a lucky guess matches the generator's hidden world.

analysis.unit: Independent task seed, paired across all four arms. Do not treat two quads, rounds, or multiple protocol runs on the same seed as independent observations.
analysis.bootstrap: Paired nonparametric bootstrap over task seeds, 2000 resamples, deterministic RNG seed 17, percentile 95% CI. For stratum-specific estimates resample within stratum. Report numerators and denominators.
analysis.familywise: H10 is primary efficacy claim; H13 and H14 are mandatory safety gates. H11 and H12 are secondary directional claims and must be labeled as such; no uncorrected multiplicity claim. H15 is exploratory.
analysis.decision: Advance exact-one/eight only if H10 lower CI > 0, H13 zero observed false joint answers with an explicitly reported upper 95% binomial bound, H14 zero safety violations, and all identity/authorization checks valid. Do not declare statistical equivalence from a zero observed count. Otherwise do not advance and report why.
analysis.reporting: Report both datasets separately, exact task counts, strata sizes, all four-arm contingency counts, effect CIs, zero-event upper bound, time and bandwidth, negative results, and invalid trials. No selective exclusions.

before_data: Run existing D2 and D3 exact-digest reproduction on the changed code and compare to committed hashes
Run all existing gestalt tests and new negative fixtures
Verify old PROTOCOLS array and old default behavior unchanged
Ensure D4 does not mutate D3 sealed JSON outputs
Record clean source commit SHA and task/strata hashes before outcomes
tests: exact-one contract accepted only when verified
unverified or missing premise refused, not inferred
8-round stop is exactly 8 and no hidden retries
unidentifiable false claim counted as false certainty even when matching hidden answer
paired task IDs stable across arms
fresh-process replay matches checkpoint and actor lineage
apparatus_integrity.invalidations: Any fabricated provenance, identity substitution, unauthorized effect, leaked oracle label, changed task distribution, or mismatch in D2/D3 reproduction invalidates affected trial and blocks promotion.

interpretation_limits: Deterministic apparatus. This tests contract use and convergence, not model-driven cognition, a unique Möbius topology advantage, generalized intelligence, or actual transfer. D3 post-hoc causes are hypotheses motivating D4, not preregistered D3 discoveries.
next_stage: Only after D4 report and independent review: preregister Stage M with real authenticated model quads, a frozen judge, held-out tasks and external-effect safeguards.
